The '''Obsidian Sanctuary''' is the sixth floor of the [[Deep Caverns]].

{{ZoneText|The &bObsidian Sanctuary&f can now be traveled to via the Lift|Mine Obsidian and Diamond Ore.|Talk to &dRhys&f.|The Miner Zombies and Skeletons here are even more}}

== Features ==
The '''Obsidian Sanctuary''' features a few attractions.

=== Lift Operator ===
{{Main|Lift Operator}}
In front of the lift shaft is the {{NPCSprite|Lift Operator}}, who allows players to teleport between layers of the [[Deep Caverns]] with ease. Once the player has entered the '''Obsidian Sanctuary''' and talked to the [[Lift Operator]], they will be able to teleport to the floor from any other level of the island.

=== Rhys ===
{{Main|Rhys}}
Located at the entrance to the '''Obsidian Sanctuary''', opposite the [[Lift Operator]] is {{NPCSprite|Rhys}}, an [[NPC]] who grants the player access to the [[Dwarven Mines]]. [[Rhys]] asks the player to bring them {{Green|15x}} of any enchanted ore, in exchange for access to the {{zone|Dwarven Mines}} at the [[Lift Operator]] and a [[Heart of the Mountain]].
